about.title: About Junior
about.story1: Junior started with a simple idea: every toy should bring joy to a child and peace of mind to parents.
about.story2: We carefully select every toy, checking its materials, quality and developmental value. Our shelves only hold toys we'd happily give to our own kids.
about.story3: Not sure what to pick? Tell us about your child — their age, personality and hobbies — and we'll help you find the toy that makes their eyes light up.
